'''2010 Canadian Nationals Cole Lepine DS Hoth''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Cole Lepine]] at [[2010 Canadian Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth (Dark)|Hoth-D-hoth.gif|label=Hoth}}
* '''Deck name:''' Cole Dark
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
